<thought>We need to find a template for the Horner‑Wadsworth‑Emmons (HWE) reaction that matches the target molecule (one of the SMILES given in the previous steps). Using the first SMILES from the precursor list as the target, we search the template catalog with criteria reflecting the HWE forward reaction: broken C‑P and C‑O bonds, formed a carboxylic acid and a C=C double bond. This will return the appropriate template_id and mapped_rxn needed to build the retrosynthesis route.</thought>
<action>search_template_catalog_by_criteria</action>
<action_input>{
  "molecule_smiles": "C/C(=C/[C@H]1O[C@@H](C/C=C/C=C/C(=O)O)C[C@H](O[Si](C)(C)C(C)(C)C)[C@H]1C)CO",
  "functional_groups_broken": ["C-P", "C-O"],
  "functional_groups_formed": ["carboxylic acid", "C=C"],
  "bonds_broken": null,
  "bonds_formed": null,
  "limit": 5
}</action_input>
